data.description:
## Story

As a CI orchestrator, `runner.py` initializes the cycle ledger (reconstructing from PR comments if absent), runs the reviewer + resolution loop for one cycle, posts an extended `DSO-Review-Cycle:` PR comment with findings tuples, invokes the cycle dispatcher to decide next action, and dispatches the cycle-end arbiter when halt conditions are met (max_cycles reached or STABLE_HALT with unresolved findings), so that PR review cycles converge automatically and arbiter rulings flow into orphan tickets / defense records.

## Done Definitions

- [ ] `runner.py` initialization step: read cycle-ledger.json (if exists at $ARTIFACTS_DIR) OR reconstruct from PR comments via `cycle_ledger.reconstruct_from_pr_comments(pr_number, repo)`. Derive cycle_num from ledger length (ledger is authoritative). Remove DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE env var as cycle source — env var is logged for visibility but not used to determine cycle_num.
- [ ] After reviewer dispatch + resolution loop completes (existing code), compute findings tuples (`stability.finding_hash` over reviewer-findings.json), compute findings_hash, write extended PR comment `DSO-Review-Cycle: K commit_sha=<HEAD> findings_hash=<h> tuples=<json>`. PR comment write is idempotent (update existing comment with same cycle K + commit_sha marker; create new only if absent).
- [ ] Append cycle entry to cycle-ledger.json via `cycle_ledger.append_cycle` with commit_sha, findings tuples, findings_hash. Atomic write.
- [ ] Call `cycle_dispatcher.next_action(ledger, max_cycles, current_findings, current_commit_sha)`. Branch on result:
  - SHORT_CIRCUIT (re-run on same SHA with existing arbiter ruling): read arbiter-rulings.json, exit with prior status code. Do NOT re-dispatch reviewer or arbiter.
  - PASS: write status, exit 0. Post final PR comment summarizing zero unresolved findings.
  - DISPATCH_NEXT: post PR comment "Cycle K complete; N findings remain; awaiting next push for cycle K+1". Exit with appropriate CI status (failure or pending — choose based on review-policy; document choice).
  - DISPATCH_ARBITER: continue to arbiter dispatch.
- [ ] Arbiter dispatch step: bundle input (unresolved findings + all prior defenses gathered from PR comments + diff + cycle metadata including ledger excerpt for cross_cycle_pattern computation + per-reviewer breakdown for cross_reviewer_agreement). Call `dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter` (handles the per-finding ruling array per Story 11).
- [ ] Pass arbiter output to `arbiter_processor.process_rulings(rulings, finding_map, cycle_num, commit_sha, pr_number=PR#, branch_name=None)` (Story 11). Processor writes arbiter-rulings.json sidecar + creates DEFER tickets + writes DROP defenses to both stores.
- [ ] Post arbiter PR comment: single comment per dispatch, format: heading with cycle number and commit SHA, table of finding_index → ruling → rationale, BLOCK list highlighted at top. Comment carries marker `DSO-Arbiter-Ruling: cycle=K commit_sha=<sha>` for idempotency detection.
- [ ] Exit with code matching status: 0 if no BLOCK in arbiter rulings; non-zero if any BLOCK present. CI check status reflects this.
- [ ] E2E test (Python) with mocked LLM dispatch verifies: (a) cycle 1 happy path; (b) cycle 2 reconstructs from cycle 1 PR comment; (c) cycle 4 triggers arbiter at max_cycles; (d) STABLE_HALT triggers arbiter early; (e) SHORT_CIRCUIT on re-run with same SHA.

## Considerations

- [PR check policy] DISPATCH_NEXT case — CI exit status: 'pending' would require a CI extension; 'failure' is conservative and re-runs on next push will re-evaluate. Choose 'failure' for initial ship; document.
- [Reconstruction error] If reconstruct-from-pr returns reconstruction_gaps=true, log warning and proceed with best-effort cycle_num. cycle_dispatcher handles gap-aware logic.
- [Idempotency] PR comment writes detect existing markers and update instead of creating duplicates. Same applies to arbiter PR comment.
- [Ordering] Depends on Stories 10, 11, 12.
- [Escalation policy] Escalate when blocked.
data.title: As a CI orchestrator, runner.py initializes the cycle ledger, dispatches reviewers, posts extended cycle markers, and invokes the arbiter at halt conditions
